tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_leave_type_policy
tools.description: Returns definitions, yearly limits, and applicability rules for various leave types in MCPHawk Inc. This tool provides a structured summary of leave types applicable to MCPHawk Inc employees. It includes details such as: - Type of leave (e.g., Sick Leave, Paternity Leave, Earned Leave, Compensatory Leave) - Maximum allowed days per calendar year - Who is eligible to take each type of leave - Brief applicability rules Note: Leave policies can change from year to year based on organizational and legal updates. This tool uses a predefined CSV file (`sample-data/leave_type_policies.csv`) to reflect the current year’s leave policy. This tool is **MCPHawk Inc** and should not be used to interpret or query policies of other countries. HR personnel, PeopleOps systems, or employee support bots can use this to surface MCPHawk Inc leave policy details. **Input:** None required. **Returns:** A dictionary mapping leave types to their attributes: - `description`: What the leave is for - `max_days_per_year`: Limit for the current calendar year - `applicability`: Who is eligible (e.g., all employees, only male employees, post-confirmation only, etc.) **Example Response:** { "sick_leave": { "description": "Short-term illness or health-related absence", "max_days_per_year": 6, "applicability": "All employees" }, "paternity_leave": { "description": "Leave for new fathers during childbirth", "max_days_per_year": 10, "applicability": "Male employees only" }, "compensatory_leave": { "description": "Leave granted in lieu of working on holidays or weekends", "max_days_per_year": 5, "applicability": "All employees with approved overtime" } }
